## [0.40.0](https://github.com/jpawlowski/hass.tibber_prices/compare/v0.39.1...v0.40.0) (2026-11-22)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **attributes:** templates, automations and dashboards that read an attribute ending in "_%" must use the "_percent" name.
